summary: Promoted the last reading-only account to a measured one. The marker question (@lease_transfer_bypass) had said in its own limitations that no execution had delivered a request carrying the CampaignTransfer marker; the transfer-campaign receipt does exactly that, so it now cites CheckRun 026b6c86522d454299d1f3ca358c009e at indices 66, 67 and 69: the trigger produced vote requests with transfer_context true, the incumbent leader serving inside its live lease answered rather than ignoring them, and it ended as a follower at the higher term where its own admission event had recorded it leading. What the receipt also shows, and what sharpens the mechanism, is that the ballot was rejected rather than granted because the candidate advertised a last entry behind the incumbent's own — so the marker removes the lease delay, not the isUpToDate log check. Two contrasts pin the difference to the marker: the same follower withheld an ordinary campaign's pre-vote under the same lease immediately before the trigger (index 65), and in the marker-absent forged-election receipt the incumbent answered neither the pre-vote nor the vote request at all (indices 12 and 16 of CheckRun ab6a2e0bcad44cc9beea9c847694939a — I verified that paired premise this turn rather than assuming it, and it holds, so no correction was needed there). The defect judgment is unchanged and stays refuted: the marker is a claim about the sender's own internal precondition, the receiver keeps no record to check it against, and the snapshot assigns it no verification duty. Two schema constraints shaped how the citation had to be recorded and are worth noting: an interpretation cannot bind an experiment belonging to another investigation, and a measured conclusion requires a fixed experiment of its own, so this account is recorded as explained with the receipt cited for corroboration, while the violated conclusion and its bound experiment stay on the sibling question where the measurement was produced. Submission validates with execution_requested=false and nothing uncited.
